mapper.select: SELECT m.seq, m.ID AS userId, m.PW AS userPw, m.name, m.birth, m.nickname, m.zipcode, m.address, m.detail_address AS detailAddress, m.email_address AS email, m.permission, m.profile_img AS profileImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM direct_sale WHERE seller_seq = m.seq) AS usedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auction WHERE create_member_seq = m.seq) AS auctionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_interest WHERE member_seq = m.seq) AS wishCount, (m.point - (SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM point_lock WHERE member_seq = m.seq)) AS point FROM member m WHERE m.ID = #{userId} AND m.status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( seq, ID, PW, name, birth, nickname, zipcode, address, detail_address, email_address, regdate, point, permission, status ) VALUES ( seqMember.nextVal, #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{name}, #{birth}, #{nickname}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{email}, SYSDATE, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE ID = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE email_address = #{email}
SELECT ID FROM member WHERE email_address = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE ID = #{userId} AND email_address = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET pw_token = #{token}, token_expiry = SYSDATE + (30/1440) WHERE ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE pw_token = #{token} AND token_expiry > SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET PW = #{userPw}, pw_token = NULL, token_expiry = NULL WHERE pw_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT w.seq AS wishSeq, c.name AS itemName FROM member_interest w JOIN category c ON w.category_seq = c.seq WHERE w.member_seq = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY c.name ASC
